Hi Gina — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum into a short POV: 

Summary of accepted success criteria (per call)
- Latency: 95th percentile response under 350ms for our 2k token average test prompts.
- Cost: target inference cost <= $0.003/token for production-like load (batching applied).
- Semantic accuracy: top-1 intent match >= 92% on the provided eval set (see attached).

POV scope and timeline
- Kickoff: Monday, 23 Nov 2026 (customer-facing kickoff + brief infra check)
- 2-week technical sprint: environment setup, data ingestion, eval runs
- Final demo & metrics review: 14 Dec 2026

Ownership
- LumenMed: Gina (POC lead), Michael Chen (DevOps) — please confirm Michael's email and IP ranges below.
- Redwood: Jonas (sales lead), Marissa (solutions / onboarding), Aditya (performance engineer).

Access and ops items we need from your side to stand up the POV
1) SSO invites: please send the RBAC list (emails + role) for SSO provisioning to marissa.cole@redwood.com. We support Okta/GSuite/Azure.
2) IP allowlist: provide public egress CIDRs for your test runner so we can pre-authorize — we will also provide our egress ranges.
3) API test account: we'll create scoped API keys and share via secure DocuSign link. We need a single service account email to attach to the keys (recommended: pov-service@lumenmed.com).
4) Sample dataset & eval prompts: drop into the Drive link or attach. The attached spreadsheet is our suggested POV scope template — fill the short columns and return.

Attachments: lumenmed-pov-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet) — short checklist, allowlist-template.csv (CSV), pov-success-metrics.md (doc)

Next steps (action items)
- Gina: confirm pov-service email and Michael's contact + IP ranges by EOD Friday (20 Nov).
- Marissa/Aditya: we'll prepare a scoped API key, pre-authorize our egress IPs, and schedule a 30-min kickoff once we have SSO invite list.

If anything above is off from your expectations, tell me now so we can adjust. Otherwise we'll treat the timeline above as the working plan.

Thanks — excited to get started.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
